name: aeonos
description: Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) agent. AEONOS checks whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode name your business today, and what to fix. It also drafts JSON-LD schema and llms.txt from your own pages. Persistent memory per caller_id, so you don't re-send context on repeat calls.

authentication.description: The hosted endpoint uses an AEONOS API key (starts with pg_) from a card credit purchase at https://aeonos.basechainlabs.com/#get-access, sent as the X-Api-Key header. Never send a wallet private key to any hosted service. To pay per call in USDC on Base, run the npm package locally (npx aeonos-mcp) so your wallet key never leaves your machine.

tools.name: aeonos_query
tools.description: Ask AEONOS any AEO/GEO question. Get citation tactics, quick wins, keyword strategy, or AI visibility advice for any website. Returns structured Markdown. 0.05 USDC per call.

tools.name: aeonos_audit
tools.description: Full AEO/GEO audit: a live check of whether AI answers name or link the site, a page check (schema, E-E-A-T, llms.txt, AI crawler rules) and a P1/P2/P3 plan. Scores only where measured. 2.50 USDC per call.

tools.name: aeonos_schema
tools.description: Generate JSON-LD Schema.org markup (FAQPage, Product, Service, LocalBusiness, HowTo). Uses only details from your page; anything missing is a clearly marked placeholder. 0.50 USDC per call.

tools.name: aeonos_llms_txt
tools.description: Generate an llms.txt file for any website, structured for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude crawlers. Every fact comes from your site; gaps are marked placeholders. 0.50 USDC per call.

tools.name: aeonos_progress
tools.description: Four Layers report (SXO, AIO, GEO, AEO): a score only where a tool measured it, otherwise 'not measured', plus your next 3 actions. 1.50 USDC per call.

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Check your remaining AEONOS credit balance. Costs 1 credit.
